hook.en: For about 100 years, Sarawak was ruled by an English family who called themselves "White Rajahs". Sabah, meanwhile, was run by a trading company. How did this happen?
hook.bm: Selama kira-kira 100 tahun, Sarawak diperintah oleh sebuah keluarga Inggeris yang menggelar diri mereka "Raja Putih". Sabah pula ditadbir oleh sebuah syarikat perdagangan. Bagaimanakah ini berlaku?

bigIdeas.en: James Brooke became Rajah of Sarawak in 1841 after helping the Sultan of Brunei end a rebellion; the Brooke family ruled until 1946.
bigIdeas.bm: James Brooke menjadi Raja Sarawak pada 1841 selepas membantu Sultan Brunei menamatkan pemberontakan; keluarga Brooke memerintah hingga 1946.

bigIdeas.en: Sabah was administered by the British North Borneo Company from 1881.
bigIdeas.bm: Sabah ditadbir oleh Syarikat Borneo Utara British mulai 1881.

bigIdeas.en: Local people resisted, e.g. Rentap and Sharif Masahor in Sarawak, Mat Salleh and Antanom in Sabah.
bigIdeas.bm: Penduduk tempatan menentang, cth. Rentap dan Sharif Masahor di Sarawak, Mat Salleh dan Antanom di Sabah.

detail.en: James Brooke becomes Rajah of Sarawak
British North Borneo Company receives its charter for Sabah
detail.bm: Syarikat Borneo Utara British menerima piagam untuk Sabah

definition.en: The Brooke family who ruled Sarawak (1841–1946).
Chartered company that administered Sabah from 1881.
definition.bm: Syarikat berpiagam yang mentadbir Sabah mulai 1881.

definition.en: Official permission from the British government to govern a territory.
definition.bm: Kebenaran rasmi daripada kerajaan British untuk mentadbir sesebuah wilayah.

question.en: How did James Brooke gain power in Sarawak?

steps.en: Sarawak was then under the Sultanate of Brunei, and local people had rebelled.
steps.bm: Sarawak ketika itu di bawah Kesultanan Brunei, dan penduduk tempatan memberontak.

steps.en: Brooke helped Raja Muda Hashim end the rebellion.
steps.bm: Brooke membantu Raja Muda Hashim menamatkan pemberontakan.

steps.en: In return he was made Rajah of Sarawak (1841).
steps.bm: Sebagai balasan beliau dilantik menjadi Raja Sarawak (1841).

answer.en: Through help in ending a rebellion, rewarded with the title of Rajah.
answer.bm: Melalui bantuan menamatkan pemberontakan, dibalas dengan gelaran Raja.
